review_queue.title: Fast Track Operations Specialist
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Provide personalized, one-to-one onboarding support to customers enrolled in Fast Track packages, ensuring a smooth and efficient implementation experience. Guide customers through A2P number onboarding processes and help resolve existing onboarding challenges based on their specific requirements. Provide compliance guidance across A2P products, ensuring customers understand applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements. Manage onboarding service-level agreements (SLAs), monitor timelines, and oversee credit utilization across assigned products. Coordinate with internal operations teams to scale onboarding volumes and support the successful implementation of customer requirements. Manage a portfolio of up to 12 customer accounts, overseeing daily workloads, priorities, and outstanding onboarding activities. Participate in weekly customer meetings to present performance metrics, review open issues, discuss progress, and identify additional onboarding needs. Respond to customer inquiries through communication channels such as Slack and ServiceNow, delivering timely, accurate, and customer-focused assistance. Assess product and service-related issues, troubleshoot basic problems, and coordinate with the appropriate teams when more advanced technical support is required. Record customer interactions accurately and categorize issues appropriately to support efficient tracking, reporting, and resolution. Monitor recurring challenges and operational trends, communicating relevant findings and recommendations to product teams to support continuous improvement. Partner with account management teams to proactively address customer concerns and communicate industry or regulatory changes that may affect onboarding experiences. Prioritize competing requests, maintain accurate records, and ensure all assigned tasks and customer commitments are completed within established SLAs. Requirements: At least 2 years of professional experience specializing in one or more Application-to-Person (A2P) messaging products. Previous experience working directly with customers, preferably in onboarding, implementation, operations, or customer success roles within a technology or telecommunications environment. Practical knowledge of A2P compliance requirements and the ability to provide appropriate guidance throughout customer onboarding processes. Ability to manage daily caseloads, handle multiple customer accounts, and consistently deliver responses and resolutions within defined SLAs. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and oversee several onboarding activities simultaneously. Demonstrated ability to independently manage customer relationships and take ownership of up to 12 assigned accounts. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the confidence to lead customer meetings, present performance metrics, and explain complex processes clearly. Strong customer service orientation, empathy, and a proactive approach to understanding and addressing customer needs. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and globally distributed teams. Adaptability, accountability, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional improvement. Availability to work the NAMER shift, Monday–Friday, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM Indian Standard Time (IST). Familiarity with Google Workspace, including Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Gemini, is preferred. Experience with reporting and performance monitoring tools is an advantage. Previous experience implementing different types of A2P phone numbers is desirable. Understanding of general CTIA guidelines and international telecommunications regulatory requirements is preferred. Experience leading customer calls, managing multiple priorities, and working within strict service-level agreements is an additional advantage. Benefits: Remote Work: Fully remote opportunity based in India, with location eligibility covering Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Delhi. Flexible Work Culture: Remote-first environment designed to support collaboration across geographically distributed teams. Competitive Compensation: Competitive pay based on the role, experience, and location. Paid Time Off: Generous time-off allowances to support work-life balance. Parental Leave: Access to parental leave benefits. Wellness Support: Dedicated wellness leave and resources to support employee well-being. Healthcare Coverage: Healthcare benefits, with provisions varying according to location. Retirement Savings: Access to a retirement savings program, subject to local eligibility. Professional Development: Opportunity to gain experience in A2P messaging, telecommunications compliance, customer onboarding, and global operations. Industry Exposure: Work at the intersection of communications technology, customer experience, and large-scale digital messaging solutions. Team Engagement: Occasional travel may be required for in-person team gatherings, customer meetings, or functional events. review_queue.title: Data Steward
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Monitor data quality and observability across foundational data assets and business-ready data products, reviewing alerts related to completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, uniqueness, freshness, and unexpected data patterns. Prioritize data issues according to business impact, data criticality, downstream usage, and risk, while identifying recurring defects and monitoring gaps. Investigate anomalies and reported defects using SQL, data profiling, metadata, lineage, and observability evidence. Trace issues across source systems, ingestion processes, ETL/ELT pipelines, transformations, data platforms, semantic layers, and downstream products to identify root causes. Assess the scope and business impact of data issues, document findings and recommendations, and assign accountability to the appropriate resolution teams. Coordinate remediation with data owners, business stewards, portfolio owners, engineers, platform teams, and system owners; track progress and escalate high-impact or recurring issues when necessary. Validate implemented fixes, confirm closure evidence, and ensure corrective actions do not create unintended downstream impacts. Support the onboarding of data products and critical data elements into enterprise data quality and observability capabilities. Translate business expectations into measurable data quality rules, monitoring thresholds, alerts, and controls, helping reduce false positives. Develop and maintain dashboards and scorecards tracking data health, issue aging, recurrence, monitoring coverage, and remediation performance. Identify opportunities to prevent recurring defects by improving upstream controls, pipelines, data contracts, source processes, documentation, and operating procedures. Contribute to data product certification, maturity assessments, metadata management, lineage validation, governance standards, stewardship workflows, and technical runbooks. Requirements At least 3 years of experience in technical data stewardship, data quality, data management, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related field. Strong SQL skills, including hands-on experience with data profiling, reconciliation, and troubleshooting. Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis across source systems, data transformations, pipelines, platforms, and downstream consumption layers. Experience defining or implementing data quality rules across dimensions such as accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, and timeliness. Familiarity with data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, or data observability platforms. Experience with Databricks and cloud-based data platforms. Knowledge of Collibra Data Quality & Observability and the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform. Familiarity with tools such as dbt, Informatica, Monte Carlo, Soda, Great Expectations, or comparable data quality and observability solutions. Experience with metadata management, data lineage, data catalogs, and data product certification. Familiarity with Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, or similar tools for managing investigation and remediation workflows. Ability to translate business expectations into measurable technical controls and communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to coordinate resolution across multiple teams and drive progress without direct authority. Experience supporting data product or federated data governance models and working in complex, global, matrixed organizations is an advantage. review_queue.title: Sales Executive - BD
review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Manage sales-related data entry activities, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timely updates across internal systems. Maintain and regularly update sales records, databases, performance reports, and other relevant documentation. Monitor and track daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance metrics to evaluate progress against business objectives. Support, guide, and coordinate the sales team to help achieve individual and collective sales targets. Monitor team performance, assess productivity, and provide regular feedback to encourage continuous improvement. Coordinate with internal departments to ensure smooth sales operations and effective communication across teams. Ensure all sales documentation, records, and reporting processes remain organized, accurate, and up to date. Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement within existing sales processes. Prepare, consolidate, and present sales performance reports and relevant business insights to management. Support the overall sales function by maintaining structured workflows and ensuring effective administrative and operational coordination. Requirements: 0–2 years of professional experience in sales, business development, or sales operations, with hands-on experience in warehousing sales being mandatory. Practical understanding of the logistics, third-party logistics (3PL), warehousing, and supply chain industries. Strong knowledge of sales processes, performance tracking, data management, and reporting procedures. Good proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word, with the ability to manage sales databases, organize information, and prepare reports. Strong leadership and team-handling abilities, with the capacity to guide, coordinate, and support sales representatives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in both Hindi and English. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple responsibilities and deadlines. High attention to detail and accuracy when handling sales data, records, and documentation. Good interpersonal and coordination skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams. Proactive attitude and problem-solving abilities, with an interest in improving sales processes and operational efficiency. Ability to work independently in a remote environment and take ownership of assigned responsibilities. Candidates must have their own laptop and the necessary equipment to perform their duties remotely. Benefits: Remote working opportunity with flexible working hours. Health insurance coverage. Informal dress code and a relaxed working environment. Friendly and collaborative workplace culture. Opportunities for rapid professional growth and career development. Exposure to the growing 3PL logistics, warehousing, and supply chain industry. Opportunity to develop sales management, reporting, and operational coordination skills. Dynamic environment offering opportunities to take ownership and contribute to business growth. Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1

review_queue.title: Workday Data Analyst
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Maintain accurate, secure, and reliable workforce records, ensuring associate data meets established quality and governance standards. Monitor and improve data accuracy, audit readiness, and integration reliability across HR technology systems. Structure, validate, and govern workforce data to ensure it is suitable for automation, AI applications, and intelligent agents. Identify recurring data defects and collaborate with Product Owners and Business Analysts to resolve underlying process issues. Execute data-quality controls, audits, security reviews, mass data loads, and corrections involving the associate master record. Analyze HR data against regulatory, privacy, and SOX compliance requirements, supporting control testing, ongoing monitoring, and audit documentation. Validate outbound data extracts and Workday integrations to ensure accurate and consistent information flows across downstream systems. Reconcile data discrepancies, troubleshoot integration issues, and monitor data flows to maintain system reliability. Support continuous improvement initiatives across data quality, governance, compliance, and integration processes. Balance priorities across quality and audit activities, SOX and compliance requirements, and integration-related responsibilities. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent qualifications. At least 5 years of experience in HR data operations, data integrations, analytics, or a related field. Hands-on experience with Workday integrations and outbound data extracts, including data validation, troubleshooting, and reconciliation. Strong understanding of HR data concepts, workforce records, data-quality controls, and data governance practices. Demonstrated knowledge of SOX and GDPR requirements, with experience supporting compliance testing, monitoring, and audit-ready controls. Ability to identify the root causes of data-quality issues and improve the underlying processes rather than relying solely on record-level corrections. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and ensure data integrity across systems. Good understanding of data security, privacy, and regulatory compliance within HR technology environments. Experience with Workday Report Writer, Workday Prism Analytics, calculated fields, EIB, or Workday Studio is an advantage. Previous experience leading global data governance or master data management initiatives in complex, multi-business environments is highly desirable. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with product, business analysis, HR, and technology stakeholders. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement within India. Full-time opportunity within a global HR Technology team. Opportunity to contribute to meaningful work supporting life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology. Exposure to enterprise-scale Workday technology, global data governance, and complex integration environments. Opportunity to develop expertise in AI-ready data management, automation, compliance, and HR technology. Collaborative environment focused on continuous improvement, innovation, and professional development. Potential for long-term career growth within a global science and technology organization. Evaluate campaign effectiveness using key business metrics, including First-Time Deposits (FTD), deposits, Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), user reactivation, and retention. Identify opportunities to improve campaign engagement, conversion, and customer retention. Monitor campaign health indicators, including deliverability, opt-out rates, notification engagement, and communication fatigue. Share customer behaviour insights and campaign learnings with Product, Marketing, and LiveOps teams to support business and product decisions. Track campaign performance against defined business objectives and communicate results accurately. review_queue.title: Demand Planner
review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: As Demand Planner, you will own forecast accuracy and the assumptions behind your assigned portfolio. You will combine statistical analysis, commercial insights, and scenario planning to anticipate changes in demand, communicate risks and opportunities, and support the organization's monthly consensus and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes. Build, validate, and publish monthly demand forecasts in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, covering baseline demand, promotional activity, new product launches, and product phase-outs. Review statistical forecasts each cycle, apply appropriate overrides, document the rationale, and maintain disciplined forecasting practices. Develop and compare forecast scenarios to assess risks and opportunities related to promotions, supply constraints, pricing changes, and other business developments. Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions. Develop launch forecasts for new products using historical analogs, marketing plans, and customer-level merchandising assumptions, then track performance against expected growth. Represent the assigned portfolio in consensus forecasting and S&OP meetings, presenting forecast changes, underlying assumptions, risks, and opportunities to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. Gather and challenge assumptions related to promotions, product launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer-specific plans. Identify and communicate demand risks and opportunities early enough to support proactive business decisions. Partner with Supply Planning to monitor inventory levels, weeks of supply, fill-rate risks, and allocation decisions, identifying potential demand and supply imbalances. Analyze retailer and channel trends using internal, point-of-sale (POS), and syndicated data to understand customer ordering behavior. Contribute demand inputs and scenario analysis to annual operating plans and long-range planning activities in collaboration with Finance and Commercial teams. Support the Anaplan implementation through user acceptance testing, data validation, and the migration of assigned accounts from Excel-based processes. Work with the Demand Planning Analyst to maintain master data accuracy, support reporting requirements, and investigate data issues affecting forecasts. Follow demand review calendars and forecast lock dates while keeping portfolio assumptions up to date between planning cycles. Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reduce manual work, and strengthen forecasting reliability. Requirements : The ideal candidate brings 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, including at least 1–2 years in demand planning or a closely related role. You should have experience managing a customer or category portfolio through a complete monthly forecasting cycle, strong analytical capabilities, and the confidence to explain and defend planning assumptions. Success in this role requires both technical proficiency and the ability to influence stakeholders across commercial and operational teams. 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, with at least 1–2 years as a Demand Planner, Demand Planning Analyst, or in an equivalent position. Experience owning a customer or category portfolio through a full monthly demand forecasting cycle. Proficiency in Anaplan, with hands-on experience using demand planning or integrated business planning platforms. Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system for managing order, shipment, and inventory history. Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and the ability to manage and analyze large datasets. Strong PowerPoint skills, with the ability to prepare clear presentations for consensus meetings and leadership discussions. Working knowledge of statistical forecasting fundamentals and the judgment to identify when commercial adjustments are necessary. Ability to document forecast assumptions, explain variances, and communicate analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to influencing stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Planning, and Commercialization. Experience in a consumer packaged goods (CPG), beverage, or manufacturing environment. Strong ownership, attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving organization. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with NielsenIQ, Circana, SPINS, or other syndicated and POS data sources. Familiarity with retailer platforms such as Retail Link or Vendor Central. Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Sigma, Power BI, or Tableau. Previous involvement in an Anaplan or comparable planning platform implementation, including user acceptance testing, data validation, or migration from spreadsheet-based planning. Anaplan Level 1 certification or equivalent platform training. Exposure to annual operating plan or budgeting cycles in partnership with Finance. Benefits : Annual compensation of $80,000–$90,000, plus bonus. Fully remote working environment. Opportunity to take ownership of a customer and product portfolio and influence business planning decisions. Exposure to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Revenue Growth Management, and Supply Planning. Opportunity to contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of Anaplan-based planning processes. Collaborative, feedback-oriented culture that values initiative, curiosity, transparency, and professional growth. Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven business focused on making consumer health more accessible. Ensure linguistic accuracy: Review Hindi-language content and datasets to assess grammar, spelling, vocabulary, fluency, cultural relevance, and overall linguistic consistency. Support LLM data preparation: Contribute to the validation, annotation, and refinement of Hindi-language datasets used for training and evaluating large language models. Monitor data quality: Identify linguistic inconsistencies, errors, ambiguities, and potential quality issues, ensuring that data meets established project guidelines and quality benchmarks. Coordinate quality workflows: Work with linguists, reviewers, data specialists, and project teams to organize quality assurance activities and maintain consistent delivery standards. Evaluate AI-generated content: Assess Hindi-language model outputs for accuracy, relevance, naturalness, contextual understanding, and alignment with linguistic and cultural expectations. Provide feedback and recommendations: Document recurring issues, communicate quality findings, and recommend improvements to annotation guidelines, review processes, and linguistic standards. Maintain project documentation: Ensure quality reports, review results, feedback records, and project-related documentation are accurate and up to date. Support continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance linguistic evaluation methods, data quality processes, and overall model training effectiveness. Collaborate across teams: Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to address quality concerns, resolve project challenges, and ensure alignment with delivery expectations. Requirements: Excellent written and spoken Hindi proficiency, with a strong understanding of grammar, syntax, vocabulary, semantics, and regional language variations. Strong English communication skills to collaborate effectively with international teams and understand project documentation and instructions. Experience in linguistic quality assurance, translation, proofreading, localization, language annotation, content review, or multilingual data projects. Understanding of AI, machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), or Large Language Model (LLM) concepts, with an interest in contributing to AI development. Familiarity with data annotation, linguistic evaluation, content validation, or quality assessment workflows. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic inaccuracies, inconsistencies, contextual errors, and subtle differences in meaning. Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating language quality and AI-generated responses. Strong organizational and coordination abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple tasks, follow detailed guidelines, and meet project deadlines. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear, constructive feedback and document quality findings. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international teams. Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and evolving AI data quality methodologies. Additional advantages: Previous experience working on LLM training, AI evaluation, or generative AI data projects. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Experience with market data inventory and usage reporting tools is a plus. SQL or scripting knowledge for reporting automation is beneficial. human_review.title: Senior Marketing Operations Specialist
human_review.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Where you'll leave your mark?: Own reporting across leads, demos, pipeline and revenue by channel and campaign. Build dashboards in HubSpot and BI tools, investigate performance changes and recommend next steps. Improve ROI and attribution reporting, with consistent metric definitions across marketing and RevOps. Manage HubSpot properties, lists, lifecycle stages and data quality. Maintain lead scoring, routing and handoff workflows in partnership with sales and RevOps. Maintain tracking across forms, UTMs, GA4 and HubSpot, and support campaign setup and launches. Automate manual processes using HubSpot workflows and tools like Zapier, n8n or Make. Build AI-powered workflows for lead research, enrichment, data cleanup and reporting. Test and monitor workflows, measure their impact and document how they work. The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations, ideally in B2B SaaS. Strong hands-on HubSpot experience and experience independently managing operational projects. Confidence analysing data in Excel or Google Sheets and building dashboards in a BI tool. A solid understanding of the B2B funnel, conversion rates and marketing-to-sales handoffs. Experience building automations and at least one practical AI-powered workflow, at work or in a side project. Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills and clear communication. Good to Have Basic SQL and familiarity with APIs, webhooks and JSON. Experience with GA4, enrichment or intent tools. Experience evaluating, rolling out and managing a MarTech or GTM tool. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

verification_backlog.title: Retail Operations Coordinator / Shop Care Assistant
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: The Retail Operations Coordinator will oversee recurring operational routines, maintain accurate reporting processes, and coordinate with store teams to ensure consistent execution of retail standards across multiple locations. Store Reporting and Analytical Auditing: Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly store performance reports across multiple locations, compare information across systems, identify discrepancies, investigate unusual figures, and maintain accurate management trackers and summaries. Cashbook and Timesheet Verification: Review employee working hours and timesheets against established schedules, audit store cashbooks, verify supporting documentation, and follow up on cash discrepancies or missing records until resolved. Visual Merchandising Compliance: Review store photographs and videos against established visual merchandising standards, identify areas requiring improvement, provide actionable feedback, and verify that requested changes have been implemented. Shop Care and Task Coordination: Serve as a key point of contact for store managers and internal Shop Care teams, maintaining clear communication, following up on outstanding requests, and ensuring operational tasks are completed on time. IT Issue Coordination: Track store-related IT issues, troubleshoot basic technical problems using available documentation, and escalate more complex cases with clear explanations of the investigation and required actions. Operational Follow-Through: Manage recurring daily, weekly, and monthly routines independently, maintain ownership of assigned tasks, and ensure that issues are properly investigated and brought to completion. Process Improvement: Use digital tools and AI-powered workflows to streamline reporting, improve operational efficiency, and maintain reliable coordination across retail locations. Requirements: The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and proactive, with the ability to independently manage operational processes and follow through on issues without constant supervision. Strong spreadsheet skills, attention to detail, and confident communication are essential. Demonstrated ability to manage recurring operational routines across multiple locations and take full ownership of tasks through to completion. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, particularly when reviewing financial records, timesheets, cashbooks, and operational reports. Solid proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel, including formulas, filters, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and pivot tables. Strong independent problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, test reasonable solutions, and escalate issues with structured information when necessary. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate confidently and professionally with store managers and internal teams. German language proficiency is a significant advantage. An eye for visual merchandising, including store presentation, layout, and compliance with brand standards. Digital proficiency and the ability to quickly learn BI, POS, workforce scheduling, and task-management platforms. Familiarity with generative AI tools and the ability to use them thoughtfully while verifying outputs and maintaining natural, effective communication. Previous experience in retail operations, operations coordination, or an analytical administrative position is highly beneficial. Dependable, self-motivated, and comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment. Benefits: Monthly Salary: Fixed compensation of INR 36,500 per month. Remote Work: Fully remote working arrangement. Employment Type: Full-time position with a 40-hour workweek. Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, with agreed availability overlapping with German business hours. Modern Digital Tools: Hands-on experience with Google Sheets, Excel, BI and POS systems, workforce scheduling platforms, task-management tools, and generative AI. Autonomy and Ownership: Significant responsibility for managing operational trackers, auditing processes, and coordinating store follow-ups. International Collaboration: Opportunity to work closely with store managers, Shop Care teams, and international colleagues. Professional Development: Exposure to international retail operations, data analysis, process optimization, and AI-supported workflows. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. verification_backlog.title: Data Steward
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Monitor data quality and observability across foundational data assets and business-ready data products, reviewing alerts related to completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, uniqueness, freshness, and unexpected data patterns. Prioritize data issues according to business impact, data criticality, downstream usage, and risk, while identifying recurring defects and monitoring gaps. Investigate anomalies and reported defects using SQL, data profiling, metadata, lineage, and observability evidence. Trace issues across source systems, ingestion processes, ETL/ELT pipelines, transformations, data platforms, semantic layers, and downstream products to identify root causes. Assess the scope and business impact of data issues, document findings and recommendations, and assign accountability to the appropriate resolution teams. Coordinate remediation with data owners, business stewards, portfolio owners, engineers, platform teams, and system owners; track progress and escalate high-impact or recurring issues when necessary. Validate implemented fixes, confirm closure evidence, and ensure corrective actions do not create unintended downstream impacts. Support the onboarding of data products and critical data elements into enterprise data quality and observability capabilities. Translate business expectations into measurable data quality rules, monitoring thresholds, alerts, and controls, helping reduce false positives. Develop and maintain dashboards and scorecards tracking data health, issue aging, recurrence, monitoring coverage, and remediation performance. Identify opportunities to prevent recurring defects by improving upstream controls, pipelines, data contracts, source processes, documentation, and operating procedures. Contribute to data product certification, maturity assessments, metadata management, lineage validation, governance standards, stewardship workflows, and technical runbooks. Requirements At least 3 years of experience in technical data stewardship, data quality, data management, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related field. Strong SQL skills, including hands-on experience with data profiling, reconciliation, and troubleshooting. Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis across source systems, data transformations, pipelines, platforms, and downstream consumption layers. Experience defining or implementing data quality rules across dimensions such as accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, and timeliness. Familiarity with data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, or data observability platforms. Experience with Databricks and cloud-based data platforms. Knowledge of Collibra Data Quality & Observability and the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform. Familiarity with tools such as dbt, Informatica, Monte Carlo, Soda, Great Expectations, or comparable data quality and observability solutions. Experience with metadata management, data lineage, data catalogs, and data product certification. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple responsibilities and deadlines. verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Maintain accurate, secure, and reliable workforce records, ensuring associate data meets established quality and governance standards. Monitor and improve data accuracy, audit readiness, and integration reliability across HR technology systems. Structure, validate, and govern workforce data to ensure it is suitable for automation, AI applications, and intelligent agents. Identify recurring data defects and collaborate with Product Owners and Business Analysts to resolve underlying process issues. Execute data-quality controls, audits, security reviews, mass data loads, and corrections involving the associate master record. Analyze HR data against regulatory, privacy, and SOX compliance requirements, supporting control testing, ongoing monitoring, and audit documentation. Validate outbound data extracts and Workday integrations to ensure accurate and consistent information flows across downstream systems. Reconcile data discrepancies, troubleshoot integration issues, and monitor data flows to maintain system reliability. Support continuous improvement initiatives across data quality, governance, compliance, and integration processes. Balance priorities across quality and audit activities, SOX and compliance requirements, and integration-related responsibilities. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent qualifications. At least 5 years of experience in HR data operations, data integrations, analytics, or a related field. Hands-on experience with Workday integrations and outbound data extracts, including data validation, troubleshooting, and reconciliation. Strong understanding of HR data concepts, workforce records, data-quality controls, and data governance practices. Demonstrated knowledge of SOX and GDPR requirements, with experience supporting compliance testing, monitoring, and audit-ready controls. Ability to identify the root causes of data-quality issues and improve the underlying processes rather than relying solely on record-level corrections. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and ensure data integrity across systems. Good understanding of data security, privacy, and regulatory compliance within HR technology environments. Experience with Workday Report Writer, Workday Prism Analytics, calculated fields, EIB, or Workday Studio is an advantage. Previous experience leading global data governance or master data management initiatives in complex, multi-business environments is highly desirable. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with product, business analysis, HR, and technology stakeholders. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement within India. Full-time opportunity within a global HR Technology team. Opportunity to contribute to meaningful work supporting life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology. Exposure to enterprise-scale Workday technology, global data governance, and complex integration environments. Opportunity to develop expertise in AI-ready data management, automation, compliance, and HR technology. Collaborative environment focused on continuous improvement, innovation, and professional development. Potential for long-term career growth within a global science and technology organization. verification_backlog.title: CLM Associate
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Campaign Planning and Execution Plan and execute weekly CLM campaign calendars across push notifications, in-app messages, email, and SMS, aligned with product events, promotional activities, and engagement initiatives. Build, launch, and manage end-to-end campaigns using CRM and marketing automation platforms such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, WebEngage, or similar tools. Configure campaign audiences, creatives, scheduling, frequency caps, quiet hours, and channel-specific delivery settings. Maintain campaign execution standards, including naming conventions, UTM tracking, approval workflows, and quality assurance checks. Validate campaign links, audience segments, messaging content, and scheduling to ensure accuracy before deployment. Coordinate with Product, Marketing, and LiveOps teams to ensure timely and consistent campaign execution. Customer Journeys and Segmentation Build, manage, and optimise automated customer lifecycle journeys covering onboarding, first-game participation, first-deposit conversion, repeat engagement, churn prevention, and user reactivation. Develop and maintain audience segments using behavioural and transactional indicators, including user recency, deposit tiers, game preferences, engagement levels, and lifecycle stages. Configure automated journey logic using triggers, time delays, conditional branches, and exit criteria. Coordinate personalised communications for VIP and high-value customers in collaboration with relevant business and LiveOps teams. Ensure communications are relevant, timely, and personalised while minimising excessive messaging and notification fatigue. Experimentation and Optimisation Plan and execute structured A/B tests across campaign copy, creatives, delivery timing, communication channels, and promotional incentives. Apply disciplined testing methodologies by changing one variable at a time and maintaining control or holdout groups wherever applicable. Evaluate campaign effectiveness using key business metrics, including First-Time Deposits (FTD), deposits, Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), user reactivation, and retention. Maintain a campaign learnings repository documenting successful experiments, underperforming campaigns, and actionable insights. Identify opportunities to improve campaign engagement, conversion, and customer retention. Reporting and Performance Analysis Own weekly CLM performance reporting, covering campaign results, customer journey performance, holdout analysis, and execution-related incidents. Monitor campaign health indicators, including deliverability, opt-out rates, notification engagement, and communication fatigue. Identify performance trends and potential engagement issues, recommending corrective actions before they negatively affect retention or revenue. Share customer behaviour insights and campaign learnings with Product, Marketing, and LiveOps teams to support business and product decisions. Track campaign performance against defined business objectives and communicate results accurately. Requirements: 1–3 years of professional experience in CRM Marketing, Customer Lifecycle Management, Retention Marketing, or Customer Engagement. Hands-on experience planning, building, executing, and monitoring campaigns using CRM and marketing automation platforms such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, WebEngage, or similar tools. Proven ability to manage high-volume campaigns with strong execution discipline and minimal errors in audience targeting, scheduling, content, and delivery. Working knowledge of customer segmentation and automated journey-building concepts, including triggers, waiting periods, conditional branches, and exit conditions. Good understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, user activation, engagement, retention, churn prevention, and reactivation strategies. Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret conversion funnels, campaign metrics, customer behaviour, and holdout results to evaluate campaign performance. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for campaign tracking, reporting, and performance analysis. Basic SQL knowledge is a strong advantage. Strong copywriting and communication skills, particularly the ability to create concise, engaging, and conversion-focused push notifications, in-app messages, emails, and SMS campaigns. Excellent attention to detail, organisational abilities, and the capacity to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously. A proactive, accountable, and customer-centric mindset, with the ability to identify issues early and continuously improve campaign performance. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Product, Marketing, LiveOps, and promotional teams. Good to have: Experience in the gaming, Real Money Gaming (RMG), fintech, or high-frequency consumer application industries. Exposure to international markets, particularly the United States or Brazil, including timezone-sensitive campaign scheduling. Experience coordinating Portuguese-language campaigns. Familiarity with communication deliverability and technical health, including push notification token health, email sender reputation, and SMS delivery routes. Experience coordinating with promotional, offers, or rewards teams where customer communications involve monetary incentives. Working knowledge of SQL for advanced audience analysis, segmentation, and campaign performance reporting. Key competencies: Detail-oriented: Maintains accuracy across campaign content, audience selection, scheduling, and execution. Execution-focused: Comfortable planning, building, testing, and launching campaigns regularly while following established quality checks. Data-driven: Uses customer behaviour, campaign metrics, and performance trends to identify opportunities and improve results. Customer-centric: Understands user preferences and communication fatigue, ensuring messages are relevant, personalised, and appropriately timed. Proactive and accountable: Takes ownership of campaign outcomes, identifies potential issues early, and continuously seeks improvements. Collaborative: Works effectively across teams to align customer communications with product and business priorities. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Annual salary ranging from INR 5 LPA to INR 10 LPA (₹500,000–₹1,000,000). Fully remote work: Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in India. Full-time opportunity: Stable, full-time professional engagement. Career development: Opportunity to grow from hands-on campaign execution into broader lifecycle marketing strategy and ownership. Practical CRM experience: Work with leading customer engagement and marketing automation platforms, including MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, and WebEngage. Cross-functional exposure: Collaborate with Product, Marketing, LiveOps, and promotional teams. Measurable business impact: Directly contribute to customer activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and reactivation. Professional growth: Develop expertise in CRM operations, customer segmentation, lifecycle automation, experimentation, and data-driven marketing. verification_backlog.title: Demand Planner
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: As Demand Planner, you will own forecast accuracy and the assumptions behind your assigned portfolio. You will combine statistical analysis, commercial insights, and scenario planning to anticipate changes in demand, communicate risks and opportunities, and support the organization's monthly consensus and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes. Build, validate, and publish monthly demand forecasts in Anaplan for an assigned portfolio of customers and SKUs, covering baseline demand, promotional activity, new product launches, and product phase-outs. Review statistical forecasts each cycle, apply appropriate overrides, document the rationale, and maintain disciplined forecasting practices. Develop and compare forecast scenarios to assess risks and opportunities related to promotions, supply constraints, pricing changes, and other business developments. Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions. Develop launch forecasts for new products using historical analogs, marketing plans, and customer-level merchandising assumptions, then track performance against expected growth. Represent the assigned portfolio in consensus forecasting and S&OP meetings, presenting forecast changes, underlying assumptions, risks, and opportunities to Sales, Revenue Growth Management, and Finance. Gather and challenge assumptions related to promotions, product launches and discontinuations, distribution changes, pricing, and customer-specific plans. Identify and communicate demand risks and opportunities early enough to support proactive business decisions. Partner with Supply Planning to monitor inventory levels, weeks of supply, fill-rate risks, and allocation decisions, identifying potential demand and supply imbalances. Analyze retailer and channel trends using internal, point-of-sale (POS), and syndicated data to understand customer ordering behavior. Contribute demand inputs and scenario analysis to annual operating plans and long-range planning activities in collaboration with Finance and Commercial teams. Support the Anaplan implementation through user acceptance testing, data validation, and the migration of assigned accounts from Excel-based processes. Work with the Demand Planning Analyst to maintain master data accuracy, support reporting requirements, and investigate data issues affecting forecasts. Follow demand review calendars and forecast lock dates while keeping portfolio assumptions up to date between planning cycles. Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reduce manual work, and strengthen forecasting reliability. Requirements : The ideal candidate brings 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, including at least 1–2 years in demand planning or a closely related role. You should have experience managing a customer or category portfolio through a complete monthly forecasting cycle, strong analytical capabilities, and the confidence to explain and defend planning assumptions. Success in this role requires both technical proficiency and the ability to influence stakeholders across commercial and operational teams. 5–8 years of professional supply chain experience, with at least 1–2 years as a Demand Planner, Demand Planning Analyst, or in an equivalent position. Experience owning a customer or category portfolio through a full monthly demand forecasting cycle. Proficiency in Anaplan, with hands-on experience using demand planning or integrated business planning platforms. Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system for managing order, shipment, and inventory history. Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and the ability to manage and analyze large datasets. Strong PowerPoint skills, with the ability to prepare clear presentations for consensus meetings and leadership discussions. Working knowledge of statistical forecasting fundamentals and the judgment to identify when commercial adjustments are necessary. Ability to document forecast assumptions, explain variances, and communicate analytical findings to non-technical audiences. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to influencing stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Supply Planning, and Commercialization. Experience in a consumer packaged goods (CPG), beverage, or manufacturing environment. Strong ownership, attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving organization. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with NielsenIQ, Circana, SPINS, or other syndicated and POS data sources. Familiarity with retailer platforms such as Retail Link or Vendor Central. Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Sigma, Power BI, or Tableau. Previous involvement in an Anaplan or comparable planning platform implementation, including user acceptance testing, data validation, or migration from spreadsheet-based planning. Anaplan Level 1 certification or equivalent platform training. Exposure to annual operating plan or budgeting cycles in partnership with Finance. Benefits : Annual compensation of $80,000–$90,000, plus bonus. Fully remote working environment. Opportunity to take ownership of a customer and product portfolio and influence business planning decisions. Exposure to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Revenue Growth Management, and Supply Planning. Opportunity to contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of Anaplan-based planning processes. Collaborative, feedback-oriented culture that values initiative, curiosity, transparency, and professional growth. Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven business focused on making consumer health more accessible. Commitment to providing reasonable accommodations during the application process and employment. Equal opportunity employer committed to considering qualified applicants fairly and without discrimination. verification_backlog.title: Hindi Quality Coordinator – LLM Data & Model Training
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Coordinate Hindi language quality activities: Support the planning and execution of linguistic quality processes for AI training, data generation, and model evaluation projects. Ensure linguistic accuracy: Review Hindi-language content and datasets to assess grammar, spelling, vocabulary, fluency, cultural relevance, and overall linguistic consistency. Support LLM data preparation: Contribute to the validation, annotation, and refinement of Hindi-language datasets used for training and evaluating large language models. Monitor data quality: Identify linguistic inconsistencies, errors, ambiguities, and potential quality issues, ensuring that data meets established project guidelines and quality benchmarks. Coordinate quality workflows: Work with linguists, reviewers, data specialists, and project teams to organize quality assurance activities and maintain consistent delivery standards. Evaluate AI-generated content: Assess Hindi-language model outputs for accuracy, relevance, naturalness, contextual understanding, and alignment with linguistic and cultural expectations. Provide feedback and recommendations: Document recurring issues, communicate quality findings, and recommend improvements to annotation guidelines, review processes, and linguistic standards. Maintain project documentation: Ensure quality reports, review results, feedback records, and project-related documentation are accurate and up to date. Support continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance linguistic evaluation methods, data quality processes, and overall model training effectiveness. Collaborate across teams: Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to address quality concerns, resolve project challenges, and ensure alignment with delivery expectations. Requirements: Excellent written and spoken Hindi proficiency, with a strong understanding of grammar, syntax, vocabulary, semantics, and regional language variations. Strong English communication skills to collaborate effectively with international teams and understand project documentation and instructions. Experience in linguistic quality assurance, translation, proofreading, localization, language annotation, content review, or multilingual data projects. Understanding of AI, machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), or Large Language Model (LLM) concepts, with an interest in contributing to AI development. Familiarity with data annotation, linguistic evaluation, content validation, or quality assessment workflows. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic inaccuracies, inconsistencies, contextual errors, and subtle differences in meaning. Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating language quality and AI-generated responses. Strong organizational and coordination abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple tasks, follow detailed guidelines, and meet project deadlines. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear, constructive feedback and document quality findings. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international teams. Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and evolving AI data quality methodologies. Additional advantages: Previous experience working on LLM training, AI evaluation, or generative AI data projects. Familiarity with annotation platforms, linguistic quality tools, and data management systems. Experience coordinating language teams, reviewers, or quality assurance workflows. Knowledge of Hindi dialects, regional expressions, cultural nuances, and contextual language usage. Academic background in Hindi, linguistics, translation studies, computational linguistics, or a related discipline. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, based in India. Opportunity to contribute to innovative multilingual AI and LLM development projects. Exposure to artificial intelligence, natural language processing, machine learning, and advanced language technologies. Opportunity to apply and develop Hindi linguistic expertise in a growing technology-driven industry. Collaboration with international teams and multilingual language professionals. Exposure to large-scale projects supporting global clients across diverse industries. Opportunities to develop expertise in AI data quality, linguistic evaluation, and model training. Dynamic and collaborative working environment focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.
